title: Umami Dense Vietnamese Kippers Braise
description: A pungent and dense Vietnamese dish featuring kippers in a rich braise, this recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters, and is satvik-friendly. It combines the bold flavors of Vietnam with the richness of kippers.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and saute until fragrant.
Add the kippers and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the fish sauce, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, and stir to combine.
Add the star anise and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and braise the kippers for 20 minutes.
Remove the kippers from the pot and set them aside.
Strain the braising liquid and discard the solids.
Serve the kippers with the braising liquid spooned over the top.
